claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this MGLL inhibitor most plausibly kills cells through a cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress/phospholipidosis off-target effect rather than MGLL inhibition, since MGLL is not a broadly lethal dependency in most cancer lines.
